title: A Static for the Echo
author: C. M. Nystrom
blurb: Silas Nakamura, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
